_comment: SCHEMA REFERENCE — this file is not loaded by the site. Copy an entry into jobs.json and edit it. Entries older than 60 days stop showing automatically, so 'posted' must be accurate.
description: One or two sentences. What the work actually is, and anything that makes it worth a look.
For someone offering themselves rather than a company hiring. 'company' is omitted for these.

_fields.kind: REQUIRED — 'hiring' (a company looking for someone) or 'available' (a person open to work).
_fields.role: REQUIRED — job title, or what the person does.
_fields.type: REQUIRED — one of: full-time, part-time, contract, internship, student.
_fields.description: REQUIRED — a sentence or two. Kept in whatever language it was submitted in.
_fields.vouchedBy: REQUIRED — the community member referring this. The whole point of the wall; do not leave it blank.
_fields.link: REQUIRED — apply URL or mailto: address.
